taxonomy.subtopic: Usual interstitial pneumonia, fibroblastic foci, and basal subpleural honeycombing

entries.learning_objective: Usual interstitial pneumonia combines basal subpleural honeycombing and temporally heterogeneous fibroblastic foci; TGF-beta is a central profibrotic mediator.

taxonomy.subtopic: GLUT1-positive proliferative and involution phases

entries.learning_objective: Infantile hemangiomas are GLUT1-positive endothelial tumors that appear after birth, proliferate rapidly in infancy, and then involute.

taxonomy.subtopic: HPV16 E6/E7, p53/RB disruption, and p16 overexpression

entries.learning_objective: HPV E7 inactivates RB, releases E2F, and produces compensatory p16 overexpression; E6 promotes p53 degradation.

taxonomy.subtopic: Bladder outlet obstruction, bilateral hydronephrosis, and oligohydramnios

entries.learning_objective: Severe posterior urethral obstruction lowers fetal urine production, causing oligohydramnios and secondary pulmonary hypoplasia.

taxonomy.subtopic: Hapten-specific type IV delayed hypersensitivity

entries.learning_objective: Allergic contact dermatitis is a type IV reaction in which haptens modify skin proteins, dendritic cells prime T cells, and memory T cells drive delayed inflammation on re-exposure.

taxonomy.subtopic: Breslow depth and vertical growth as prognostic determinants

entries.learning_objective: Breslow thickness quantifies vertical invasion and is a major prognostic determinant for localized cutaneous melanoma.

taxonomy.subtopic: Fanconi syndrome and generalized proximal solute wasting

entries.learning_objective: Fanconi syndrome localizes to the proximal tubule and causes urinary loss of glucose, phosphate, amino acids, bicarbonate, and low-molecular-weight proteins.

taxonomy.subtopic: Malignant osteoid, metaphyseal growth, and RB1 association

entries.learning_objective: Osteosarcoma is a metaphyseal malignant bone tumor that produces osteoid and is associated with RB1 and TP53 pathway defects.

taxonomy.subtopic: B-cell infection and reactive CD8-positive atypical lymphocytes

entries.learning_objective: EBV uses CD21 to infect B cells, while the atypical lymphocytes of infectious mononucleosis are predominantly reactive CD8-positive T cells.

taxonomy.subtopic: HHV-8 spindle-cell vascular proliferation in immunodeficiency

entries.learning_objective: Kaposi sarcoma is an HHV-8-associated spindle-cell vascular neoplasm with slit-like spaces and red-cell extravasation, especially in immunodeficiency.

taxonomy.subtopic: Articular cartilage loss, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophyte formation

entries.learning_objective: Osteoarthritis results from articular-cartilage degeneration and subchondral remodeling, producing joint-space narrowing, sclerosis, cysts, and osteophytes.

taxonomy.subtopic: UVB-induced keratinocyte dysplasia and progression to squamous carcinoma

entries.learning_objective: Actinic keratosis is UV-induced keratinocyte dysplasia confined to the epidermis and is a precursor of cutaneous squamous-cell carcinoma.

taxonomy.subtopic: Sarcoptes burrows and delayed hypersensitivity pruritus

entries.learning_objective: Scabies produces nocturnal pruritus and burrows; symptoms reflect delayed hypersensitivity to mites and their products after sensitization.

taxonomy.subtopic: Resorption distal to airway obstruction and ipsilateral mediastinal shift

entries.learning_objective: Airway obstruction causes distal gas resorption and lung-volume loss, pulling the mediastinum toward the atelectatic side.

taxonomy.subtopic: TGF-beta-driven collagen deposition beyond original wound boundaries

entries.learning_objective: Keloids are TGF-beta-associated fibroproliferative scars that extend beyond the original wound; hypertrophic scars remain confined to it.

taxonomy.subtopic: C5-C6 injury and Erb-Duchenne posture

entries.learning_objective: Erb-Duchenne palsy localizes to the C5-C6 upper trunk and causes loss of shoulder abduction/external rotation and elbow flexion/supination.

taxonomy.subtopic: Unopposed neutrophil elastase and misfolded hepatic protein retention

entries.learning_objective: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency causes emphysema through unopposed elastase and liver disease through intracellular retention of misfolded protein.

taxonomy.subtopic: Terminal ileal bile-salt loss, fat malabsorption, and calcium oxalate stones

entries.learning_objective: Terminal-ileal bile-salt loss causes fat malabsorption; fatty acids bind calcium, freeing oxalate for colonic absorption and causing enteric hyperoxaluria.

taxonomy.subtopic: Optic-chiasm compression and bitemporal hemianopia

entries.learning_objective: Pituitary macroadenomas compress crossing nasal retinal fibers in the optic chiasm, producing bitemporal hemianopia.

taxonomy.subtopic: Premature trypsin activation, fat necrosis, and hypocalcemia

entries.learning_objective: Acute pancreatitis causes enzyme-mediated fat necrosis; released fatty acids bind calcium to form soaps, producing hypocalcemia.
